You: Soon I think. I talked with her about it and she said that it should be alright. But don’t you do anything weird to her!
Lady Annalie: I wouldn’t dare~
Lady Annalie: This is really exciting news! I just hope she will live up to the hype!
You: What hype? 
Lady Annalie: Oh well, you know, you are protecting her so much that she must be a real treasure. I have high expectations for her.
You: S-she is like any other girl, really, so don’t overthink things.
Her having this much interest in {f_botName} can end up badly. If she discovers she’s a sexbot I will be in trouble.
Lady Annalie: Don’t worry, I won’t do anything weird to her. 
Lady Annalie: I’m really excited though! I hope you come here with her soon!
